title: Content Factory Reliability v2 historical failure replay corpus

evidencePolicy.exactHistoricalOutputRule: Use only when the raw failed provider output is durably retained and replayed unchanged.
evidencePolicy.syntheticReproductionRule: Use the smallest generic reproduction when the raw failed provider output is unavailable; bind it to durable run/error/remediation evidence and label it synthetic.
evidencePolicy.note: This corpus makes no exact-historical-output claim for a failed provider candidate. Existing durable evidence proves failure classes, errors and remediations, but the raw failed model candidate is not used as a fixture here. Any later promotion to exact_historical_output requires a retained raw fixture path and unchanged replay evidence.

defectClasses.summary: Question Family list output used a provider-incompatible top-level array schema instead of an object envelope.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay the provider-facing Question Family contract and require a top-level object containing questionFamilies while preserving list-shaped domain output.

defectClasses.summary: Assessment Item provider output could drift on deterministic target fields, including an out-of-enum format.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Return conflicting provider-authored target fields and prove Revision excludes them from the provider schema and injects the governed component, family, requirement, mark and format values.

defectClasses.summary: Independent review returned synthetic workUnitId assessment-set instead of a governed work-unit identity.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Recreate the historical assessment-set value and prove the provider cannot author workUnitId; Revision derives scope from the referenced governed artifact or leaves assessment-level findings unscoped.

defectClasses.summary: Practice generation could return an unplanned mode because the provider schema was broader than the Learning Blueprint-selected modes.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Exercise Blueprint-derived Learn/Practice schemas across allowed mode combinations and prove unselected Practice modes and provider-owned IDs/mode identity are outside the provider contract.

defectClasses.summary: A Learning Blueprint work unit required Practice output while selecting no Practice mode.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Construct the historical contradiction between required Practice output and empty Practice-mode selection and replay it through the current Learning Blueprint compiler boundary.

defectClasses.summary: Learning/coverage evidence could self-reference or claim application evidence that did not substantively prove the governed requirement.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay weak/self-referential coverage and application evidence through current teaching-point and coverage-finalization integrity checks.

defectClasses.summary: Structured assessment output could violate command, mark, MCQ or coverage integrity while remaining superficially parseable.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay structurally plausible assessment outputs with inconsistent command/mark/coverage semantics through deterministic assessment integrity validation.

defectClasses.summary: Practice exact-evidence locators could be accepted without deterministic evidence binding; the same generic class recurred in Pilot #15.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay Practice evidence with invalid or non-exact locators and require deterministic evidence binding rather than provider-authored locator trust.

defectClasses.summary: Assessment Item generation could drift from the governed command/demand contract.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay command/demand mismatches through the assessment integrity compiler and require the governed demand to survive normalization.

defectClasses.summary: Assessment response-demand generation could diverge across provider and deterministic command metadata.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay response-demand inconsistency and require one deterministic command/response-demand contract across assessment generation.

defectClasses.summary: Marking Pack aggregate AO allocation disagreed with its subquestion AO allocations (historical ao2 expected 8, actual 7).
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Recreate inconsistent provider-authored AO totals and require Revision to derive structured aggregate AO totals deterministically from validated subquestion allocations.

defectClasses.summary: Assessment Item response type disagreed with the governed target (historical expected exam_long_answer, actual extended_response).
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Recreate the historical response-type mismatch and require targeted normalization/repair at the assessment-item boundary without broad regeneration.

defectClasses.summary: Learner-facing ClassMaterials could contain private answer/solution or marking metadata.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Inject private answer/marking metadata into learner-facing output and require the generated-output integrity compiler to reject it.

defectClasses.summary: Content Assertion review evidence could point to a placeholder heading without substantive supporting text.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Provide hollow assertion evidence and require deterministic evidence-substance validation to fail closed.

defectClasses.summary: Marking Pack subquestion AO allocations could use fractional values inconsistent with whole-mark assessment allocation.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay fractional subquestion AO allocation and require whole-mark AO allocation integrity.

defectClasses.summary: Calculation marking guidance could omit sufficiently operational accuracy/method treatment for the marks available.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay calculation rubric guidance without required method/accuracy treatment and require complete deterministic diagnostics or one bounded repair.

defectClasses.summary: Compare/explain assessment wording could permit isolated description without securely eliciting the governed application/analysis demand.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay assessment demand that drops required application/analysis and require deterministic assessment/output integrity checks to reject it.

defectClasses.summary: Assessment Item top-level maxMark could disagree with the sum of subquestion marks (historical 30 versus 29).
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Recreate conflicting top-level maxMark and subquestion totals and prove the provider no longer owns top-level maxMark; Revision derives it from the subquestions.

defectClasses.summary: A parseable Marking Pack could contain multiple independent operational-rubric defects while the old path surfaced only the first before its one repair.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Use one Marking Pack candidate with simultaneous method-treatment, accuracy-treatment and extended-response-level defects; collect all diagnostics, perform at most one repair, then revalidate the complete artifact and fail closed if any defect remains.

exclusions: Initial live-pilot configuration/secret setup and harness timeout are operational incidents, not generated-output contract classes.
The live integration test hit Vitest's 5-second default timeout before durable model-output evidence was produced; this is a harness failure, not a Q2 contract class.
The underlying assessment-component-format-mismatch educational finding is not reclassified as a provider-contract failure by this corpus.
The pipeline reached independent educational review and correctly returned fail_hold; educational findings are assurance outcomes, not Q2 engineering contract classes.
Cross-workflow durability, checkpoint persistence and cumulative spend are restart/operations concerns and belong to restart/reuse qualification rather than Q2 output replay.
Resume lifecycle/state handling found around the same pilot is operational restart behaviour and is not treated as a historical provider-output class.
The decision to pause further paid pilots and introduce qualification governance is a process/governance response, not an additional Q2 defect class.
Independent review also contained course-specific educational judgements about pedagogy and learner usefulness; only reusable deterministic/compiler defect classes are replayed in Q2.

nextEvidence: Run the complete provider-free replay suite on one exact V2-B head.
Keep Q2 PASS false until same-head assurance proves every referenced replay test and corpus invariant is green.
Proceed to V2-C adversarial mutation matrix only after the V2-B branch is reviewed and merged under normal Founder approval.
